summary: BGM Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement of 200 million Class A ordinary shares at $0.06 per share, with warrants for up to 200 million additional shares in two tranches at 200% and 250% of the subscription price. The placement is expected to close in June 2026, and proceeds will be used for working capital. This is a follow-on capital raise, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved. The filing is routine for a foreign private issuer.
